steps.text: Place banana, tofu, sugar, cocoa powder, soy milk, and cinnamon into a blender. Cover, and puree until smooth.
Pour into individual serving dishes, and refrigerate for 1 hour before serving.

raw_recipe.headline: Chocolate-Banana Tofu Pudding
raw_recipe.description: This delightful, guilt-free tofu pudding recipe can be made in 5 minutes. It’s a dessert for everyone, vegans and chocolate lovers alike. The banana and chocolate mask the tofu.
raw_recipe.name: Chocolate-Banana Tofu Pudding

recipeInstructions.text: Place banana, tofu, sugar, cocoa powder, soy milk, and cinnamon into a blender. Cover, and puree until smooth.
Pour into individual serving dishes, and refrigerate for 1 hour before serving.

review.reviewBody: I submitted this recipe and am glad to hear that others are enjoying it. I have two tips. I find that using a frozen banana imparts a more intense banana flavor. Plus it chills the pudding instantly so you can eat it sooner :) Also, add a tsp of vanilla if you use regular cow's milk.

I found this very satisfying especially after 6 weeks of no wheat or sugar. I use regular medium firm tofu since Silken is hard to find. Then I add 1/2 or more macadamia nut milk till it's the right consistency. A very ripe banana, Dutch processed cocoa and 1/4 cup erythritol sweetener (not bitter like stevia) make this a delicious and low carb desert. Down 25 pounds and blood sugar and pressure are back to health levels.

OMG I can't believe how wonderful this recipe came out! I wanted to lick the whole bowl. It had no "odd" taste (even though I would have eaten it anyway) I made it according to some of the other reviews: I used two medium bananas for flavor (not frozen), the silken tofu 12 oz., no sugar, so I used 4 (you can taste) artificial sweetener packets; 3 T of the unsweetened cocoa powder; 4 T soy milk (not even vanilla); 1 t cinnamon. I did add 1 T peanut butter because I love it. Spun it in my cuisinart and then put in some pretty glasses. (made 4) and topped with a few chopped walnuts. Beautiful and delicious. No wheat, no milk. Yummm

I found that this had a very powdery taste from the cocoa powder. After some research i have found the following: To mix cocoa powder with a liquid (or really, to mix any powder with a liquid - salt and granulated sugar aren't powders), you need to make a slurry by mixing a small part of the liquid into all of the powder. Then you can dilute the slurry with the rest of the liquid.
So by just putting all of the ingredients in the blender at once, you will ruin batch after batch unless you use the slurry method for the cocoa powder.

Very tasty, quick and easy! I will be making this again, as soon as I get some more tofu!

I left out the soya milk and sugar as my banana made it sweet enough for my taste. I prefer a dark chocolate taste. I also ate it straight away without chilling it and for me, it was perfect! 

Seems like quite a forgiving recipe and next time I'm going to try adding a bit of rum or coffee and some semi blended chunks of banana. 

Could also turn it into a smoothie / sports recovery drink, by blending with more soy milk and ice...

This is really good. I don't love tofu, and really made this so that my son could have a sweet treat that had some nutritional value. I used two bananas, a bit more than a pinch of cinnamon, skim milk, and a little over a teaspoon of vanilla. MUCH better than any other recipies I've tried.

Great fix for a sweet tooth. Super easy to make. I added chia seeds which gave it a great texture and garnished with dark chocolate chips. Will use less cocoa next time, as I think it was a bit overpowering.

I used the frozen banana as suggested in the submitter’s comment. Used 4 tbsp maple syrup instead of confectioners’ sugar. The result had a very noticeable tofu flavor. I added one tbsp sunbutter and it was much improved. Peanut or almond butter would probably work similarly; I used sunbutter because our school is nut free. My kids love it. Will be making this regularly!

I loved this vegan pudding! To make it a little better for hubby & I, I added 2 Tbl of natural peanut butter, 1 1/2 Tbl of soy protein powder & 1 Tbl turmeric. Delicious! On top of hubby's I put a vegan dark chocolate covered strawberry.
Great dessert! I used about 1/2 cup confectioners' sugar, and added 1 tsp vanilla. Served mini marshmallows on top.

Good for what it is...a dessert substitute. Taste is bitter; I decrease the cocoa by 1 tbsp and increase the sugar to 1/3 cup to make it more palatable. It does have a nice mousse consistency and is good with granola.
Blegh! I was inspired by the reviews but no one in my family ate more than a bite. I followed the recipe exactly.
I love this recipe although I did substitute date syrup for the sugar.
This is an incredible recipe. Great for avoiding dairy and added sugar. I also add vanilla and omit the cocoa for a vanilla pudding version.

I was looking for something non-dairy to take to Thanksgiving as I have a family of vegans attending! Well! I just made a half batch of this to try out for me lol and looks like I'll be eating it all myself! DELISH! You can certainly play around with how much cocoa or cacao powder you use...I used 2 & 1/2 tablespoons and it is pretty chocolately...I only used 1 tablespoon of powdered sugar but really it's still very good and almond milk as it's all I had. Will be serving it in small 2 or 3oz plastic cups with little spoons...and maybe add a topping of some kind..even a fresh raspberry or something! A keeper!! :)
I only added an extra half a banana and about a half tsp of vanilla...plenty sweet (bananas were very ripe), and tasted like chocolate banana pudding, very tasty!
Love it

good. No, you cannot taste the tofu. All the tofu I had was extra firm and it came out with a perfect texture. Also, use a fozen banana (if you are like me and keep frozen bananas) so you can eat it right away. I omit the cinnamon, it tastes better that way....chocolate and banana yes, but chocolate, banana and cinnamon -- maybe for someone else but not us. Great pudding. Thank you very much for the recipe!
It had a great texture but I found the tofu taste overpowered the rest. I topped it with some raspberries, whipped topping, and almonds.
This was really good! It was so healthy! I used honey instead of sugar and I added vanilla.
